content:
The probability is the ratio of the shaded sector’s area to the whole disk’s area, which depends only on its central angle.

Let \(x\) be the central angle of the shaded sector. Along the upper semicircle, the angles sum to \(180^\circ\):
\[
40^\circ+x+45^\circ+25^\circ=180^\circ
\]
\[
x=70^\circ.
\]
Thus the probability is
\[
\frac{70^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac{7}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
